verdict.rationale: Elastic's docs offer official skills that teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch, a form of agent-oriented documentation an agent can be pointed at. However, probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no markdown docs endpoint (docs.md 404), and the skills' format, coverage and depth are undocumented. The MCP server belongs to a separate story and is not credited here. missing for 10: a working llms.txt, machine-readable markdown docs, detail on what the agent skills cover and how to install them, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Install official skills that teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch, Kibana, Fleet, and the rest of the Elastic stack.
